thread:
alex: Heads-up — planning release for router v2.3.1 + runtime kernel update in tonight's 02:00 UTC change window. Need API & Console pin check. Deploy-bot will run the canary. Release notes: http://go/release/642

deploy-bot: Deploy-bot: starting preflight checks for release 642. Required approvals: @taylor @sanjay. CI smoke: passing.

taylor: Can we pin the API schema to v1.8.0 during the rollout? runtime's kv-eviction flag changes header expectations.

sanjay: Agree. Pin API->runtime contract to 1.8.0. Console should keep the old header read route for at least 1h as a fallback.

jen: Console can enable compatibility layer, but we'll need the migration flag toggled on deploy. I'll add migration_flag=true to the notes.

alex: Two decisions: 1) Pin API to v1.8.0 until canary reaches 100%. 2) Auto-rollback if p95 latency >300ms for 3m or error rate spike. Everyone okay?

mike: OK. Also request deploybot steps to drain: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 15m holds so we can validate telemetry between steps.

deploy-bot: Deploy-bot: canary plan scheduled. Steps:
1) push pinned variants
2) traffic ramp: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 15m hold each
3) monitors: p95 latency, error rate, runtime CPU, cache-miss rate
Auto-rollback triggers: >5% errors OR p95 > 300ms for 3m OR cache-miss rate >2% sustained for 5m.
Commands for ops if needed:
```
# start canary
deploybot start --release 642 --pin api=v1.8.0 --stages 10,50,100 --hold 15m
```

taylor: Note: runtime increases KV cache TTL in this build — watch cache-miss metric. If miss_rate > 2% drop traffic and unpin.

jen: Console will add a dashboard and ops alert for cache-miss and header-mismatch logs (alert -> #eng-oncall).

sanjay: Add manual 'unpin API' step in the runbook for hotfixes where console needs rollback without touching runtime.

alex: I'll update the release notes and runbook with the pinned variants and rollback playbook. @deploy-bot queue for 02:00 UTC window. Everyone ack? :thumbsup:

mike: ack
taylor: ack
jen: ack
sanjay: ack

deploy-bot: Deploy-bot: preflight passed, window reserved 02:00-03:00 UTC. CI artifacts pinned. I'll post progress updates in this thread during the rollout. Closing preflight unless new blockers.
